notes.title: Patch 0.7.1 – Light Up a New Glint
notes.content:
Light Up a New Glint

"Start Settlement" is now "Start Glint"!
The term Glint better reflects the short-lived, magical nature of each step in your journey like a flicker of light in a darkening world.

📜 New Descriptions Added

You'll now find descriptions for Quests, Favors, and Tavern Trials in the game UI!

✨ What’s a Glint?

Each deck you play through is called a Glint (a short, magical step on your journey).

Your settlement begins anew each time, but your knowledge, favors, and level persist.

The more light you collect, the faster you’ll level up and expand your deck.

🐞 Fixes & Feedback

We hear you — and we’ve already addressed a few issues from your feedback.

This patch includes small bug fixes and localization improvements.

Want to contribute more? Join our Discord Server: https://discord.gg/AYNhSecwxP

Thanks for playing and lighting up Glintland! 💡

notes.title: Glintland at LEVEL UP Salzburg
notes.content:
When & Where:
June 28–29, 2025, starting at 10:00 AM each day
Messezentrum Salzburg – Indie Area, organized by FH Salzburg


What to expect:
Join us in the vibrant Indie Games Area with over 40 indie booths and discover Glintland up close. Play the latest version of the game, give feedback directly to the devs, and chat about the inspirations behind its charming mix of calm strategy and puzzle factory building.


Live Streams & EDU Zone:
Popular streamers will be broadcasting directly from the Indie Area, and you can explore the educational zone featuring hands-on demos of game engines, 3D printing, and more.


Why Glintland belongs here:
Glintland fits right into this creative festival environment — a game for dreamers and tinkerers alike. It’s cozy, clever, and crafted with love. LEVEL UP brings together gamers, families, streamers, and developers, making it the perfect place to showcase this unique indie experience.


Visitor Highlights:
– Play live: Try Glintland at the booth and share your feedback
– Meet the devs: Talk directly with the creators
– Streamer spotlight: Watch or join live coverage from the Indie Area
– Community & networking: Connect with fans, developers, and indie enthusiasts
